entries.defect: Registration decal is mirrored (flipped UVs)
entries.fix: Fix the decal UV orientation and remove stray meshes

entries.condition: UI readability: HUD overlay legibility and occlusion check on still_grid.png; still.png 1920x1080, fixed close camera on the cabin side, clear day 15:30, aircraft afloat, sun test
entries.evidence: HUD panels read KIAS 10, ALT FT 7, VS 0, HDG 240, THR 0%, RPM 600, FIXED 15:30; panels are small translucent rectangles in the corners, heading tape centred at E1, camera/clock tag at H8; nothing is occluded that the reference composition needs
entries.defect: Labels (KIAS, ALT FT, THR, RPM) are 8-9 px tall and low contrast against bright sky; units are inconsistent (ft, %, knots implied).
entries.fix: Increase label size to >=12 px, add a subtle drop shadow, and expose a HUD-off toggle for screenshots.

entries.condition: FPS and frame-time stability: metrics.json profile of the still, software rasterizer (Chromium SwiftShader, no GPU); judged relatively across the 13 views, absolute ms are not FPS; still.png 1920x1080, fixed close camera on the cabin side, clear day 15:30, aircraft afloat, sun test
entries.evidence: 5.89 M triangles and 1305 draw calls per frame; profile avg 4297 ms, p95 4434 ms (+3.2% over avg) across 8 frames; flight step+render avg 683 ms; 0 console errors. Mid-slow profile (avg 4297 ms) for a close-up that should be cheap.
entries.defect: Draw-call count above 1000 with 3.6-8.9 M triangles indicates unbatched, uninstanced scene submission that will not hold 60 FPS on a mid-range GPU
entries.fix: Instance trees, houses, boats and bridge piers, merge static city geometry per chunk, add LOD meshes for buildings and vegetation, and target <400 draw calls per frame
